## Code and output

Inline code: use `dplyr::filter()` to subset.

Block code with CRI left-border styling:

```r
library(tidyverse)

df |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(response,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Callout boxes

::: {.box-green}
**Standard note** — MachGreen border, light gray background.
:::

::: {.box-lightgreen}
**Positive result** — MachLightGreen accent for good news or confirmations.
:::

::: {.box-blue}
**Information** — teal-blue for background context or methodological notes.
:::

::: {.box-red}
**Warning** — muted red for caveats, limitations, or watch-out points.
:::

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=7}
plot(
  pressure,
  col  = "#3C5454",
  pch  = 19,
  xlab = "Temperature (°C)",
  ylab = "Pressure (mmHg)"
)
```
